_README_COMMENTS: Keys starting with '_' are comments/documentation and are ignored by the generator.
_README_USAGE: Edit case_name, stl_files, and flow conditions. All other fields use robust built-in defaults.
_stl_files: ASCII STL geometry files located in the fixed stl/ directory (project root)
_fidelity: Presets: 'fast' (~3-5M cells, ~10-20 min, y+~50), 'standard' (~9-13M cells, ~1-2 hrs, y+~30, RECOMMENDED for general aerodynamics), 'fine' (~20-28M cells, ~4-6 hrs, y+~1). Each preset carries a near-wall y+ target converted to an absolute first-layer thickness from the flow velocity and fluid properties; targets sit near the achievable value for an auto-refined surface (the clamp + CLI warning report when features force finer wall cells). All presets use Spalding-bridging wall functions, so 'fine' is wall-function-bridged at low y+ (not classical wall-resolved).

flow._velocity_comment: Freestream air velocity in m/s (16.67 m/s ≈ 60 km/h, 20.0 m/s = 72 km/h)
flow._direction_comment: Flow direction vector: +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z (direction the air travels)
flow._ground_comment: true = moving ground wall at freestream velocity; false = slip wall (free-air aero)

outputs._drag_axis_comment: Axis along which aerodynamic drag is reported (direction of freestream flow)
outputs._downforce_axis_comment: Axis along which downforce (-lift) is reported (-y = toward ground, +y = aircraft lift)

_domain_box_comment: 'auto' automatically fits wind tunnel around STL (4L upstream, 8L downstream, 4H top, 4W lateral). Or provide explicit {'min': [x, y, z], 'max': [x, y, z]}.
_symmetry_plane_comment: Centerline coordinate if model uses a symmetry plane (0.0 if centered at origin, or specify offset if origin is shifted). Omit if full 3D model.
_ground_position_comment: Optional ground elevation control (delete leading '_' from ONE key below to activate; omit both to snap to lowest STL vertex):
_ground_clearance_desc: Style 1 (Relative): Gap in meters below lowest STL point (e.g. 0.035 = 35mm ground clearance / ride height)
_ground_plane_desc: Style 2 (Absolute): Fixed CAD coordinate of ground / road elevation (e.g. 0.0 if geometry is positioned relative to origin)
_domain_faces_comment: Boundary types for the 6 outer box faces (-x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z). Available types: inlet, outlet, ground, farField, symmetry.
_patches_comment: Optional: rename the generated boundary patches. Values are the patch names written to blockMeshDict/0-fields; roles map to domain_faces types. The defaults are shown.
_vehicle_comment: Optional: only needed for aero-balance / centre-of-pressure handoff in telemetry. wheelbase in metres; front_weight_pct = static front axle load percentage (0-100).
_surface_check_comment: Pre-mesh surfaceCheck gate. enabled runs it and reports; enforce aborts the run on a defect. A symmetry half model is exempt from the closure requirement.
_feature_extract_comment: Feature edges for snappyHexMesh. includedAngle (degrees) is the threshold BELOW which an edge is kept as a feature; 140 captures real aero edges without cosmetic CAD seams. The generator derives resolveFeatureAngle from the STL crease histogram and only sharpens this, never loosens it.
_field_outputs_comment: Diagnostic outputs for inspecting the spatial load map in ParaView (open test.foam) and for telemetry. wall_shear_stress: per-face surface field (skin friction / separation). y_plus: writes the y+ field. field_min_max: small text reduction giving the max y+ value and its location (volume fields). surface_field_value: per-patch wall-pressure min/max/average sampled from p -- OFF by default because it aborts the run if a patch does not exist; set true (all STL patches) or a list of patch names. vorticity: opt-in volume field for wake/vortex visualization. Set a flag false to suppress.

parallel._comment: Number of CPU cores for MPI decomposition, snappyHexMesh meshing, and simpleFoam solving

slurm._comment: SLURM cluster configuration for HPC / compute cluster
slurm._time_comment: Optional walltime. Omit to follow the fidelity preset (fast 04:00, standard 08:00, fine 14:00).
slurm._mem_per_cpu_comment: Optional memory per CPU. Omit to follow the fidelity preset (fast 2G, standard 2G, fine 4G).

_overrides_note: All fields below have built-in defaults in fidelity presets. Uncomment only if manual tuning is needed.
_expert_defaults_note: Solver-coupled sections (schemes, relaxation, linear_solvers, simple, wall_functions, snap, and the snappy layer/mesh_quality knobs) are intentionally NOT shown here: the generator sets them per fidelity preset and overriding them can destabilise the solve. The complete default set lives in DEFAULT_CONFIG in src/rapidfoam/config.py.

mesh_params._cells_per_length: Auto base cell = longest STL extent / this number (fast 20, standard 30, fine 37.5)
mesh_params._base_cell_size: Explicit metres; use 'auto' to derive from cells_per_length
mesh_params._auto_size: false (default) = use the preset levels unchanged. true = feature-based auto-sizing: raise surface/edge refinement so the smallest geometry feature (robust low-percentile STL edge) is resolved. Never coarsens the preset.
mesh_params._feature_cells: Target cells across the smallest feature (fast 3, standard 4, fine 5). Higher only affects the fine local refinement.
mesh_params._max_surface_level: Hard cap on auto-sizing refinement level (fast 6, standard 7, fine 8) to bound the cell budget. Auto-sizing reports a warning when it clamps here.
mesh_params._feature_percentile: Expert: edge-length percentile used as the small-feature estimate (default 10.0). Lower = more aggressive (chases CAD slivers); raise to ignore tessellation noise.
mesh_params._auto_feature_angle: false (default) = use the preset value. true = derive resolveFeatureAngle from the STL crease (normal-angle) histogram so subtle creases are snapped. Only ever sharpens detection (never looser than the preset).
mesh_params._grading: Background blockMesh grading: 'off' (default), 'auto' (grade toward the ground/symmetry planes using grading_ratio), or [gx, gy, gz]. 'auto' trims cells but raises non-orthogonality/aspect ratio.
mesh_params._grading_ratio: Far/near cell-size ratio for auto grading (default 3.0, range 1-20).
mesh_params._crease_angle_floor: Expert: normal angles (deg) below this are treated as smooth tessellation, not creases (default 15).
mesh_params._feature_angle_ratio: Expert: fraction of the sharpest crease's normal angle kept as the resolve threshold (default 0.75). Lower = sharper/more aggressive feature detection.

_optional_overrides_example._mesh_quality_verdict_bands_comment: Good/caution thresholds for the mesh-quality verdict shown by 'read_forces.py --mesh' and the Studio Mesh Quality panel. These are advisory CFD-practical bands, independent of the snappyHexMesh pass/fail limits (mesh_quality.maxNonOrtho / maxInternalSkewness). 'good' = healthy; a value past 'caution' is flagged as marginal/bad. Deep-merge: you may set only one of the pair against the default.

_verdict_bands._max_non_ortho: Degrees. Above ~60 the segregated solver becomes less robust (default good 60, caution 70).
_verdict_bands._max_aspect_ratio: High aspect is expected in boundary layers; default good 50, caution 100.
_verdict_bands._min_determinant: Cell wellposedness; higher is better (default good 0.05, caution 0.001).
_verdict_bands._min_interp_weight: Face interpolation weight; ideal ~0.5 (default good 0.1, caution 0.01).
_verdict_bands._min_volume_ratio: Neighbour cell volume ratio; smoother is better (default good 0.05, caution 0.01).
_verdict_bands._concave_cells: Any concave cell is a concern (default good 0, caution 0).

mesh_quality._layering_relaxed: meshQualityControls override for the two-pass layering pass (system/snappyHexMeshDict_layering). Defaults to {"maxNonOrtho": 80, "maxInternalSkewness": 8} -- a real relaxation of the layer gate, not a disable. Tune per case only if needed.

layers._y_plus_target: Near-wall target. 1 = wall-function-bridged at low y+ (first cell in the sublayer), 30-100 = wall-function regime. Overrides first_layer_thickness unless that is set explicitly.
layers._relativeSizes: false = first_layer_thickness/min_thickness are metres; true = fractions of the local cell size
layers._first_layer_thickness: Metres when relativeSizes is false, fraction of cell size when true
layers._min_thickness: Same units as first_layer_thickness. Must not exceed the total layer stack. Leave unset to auto-derive as the first layer.
layers._min_thickness_ratio: Fraction of the derived first layer used as minThickness. Default 0.35 keeps partial layer stacks instead of dropping them, improving coverage on hard geometry at the cost of thinner prisms. 1.0 restores the all-or-nothing full-first-layer gate.
layers._ground_layers: Off by default. Opt-in prism layers on the moving ground patch; requires at least max(2 mm, 2x first layer) clearance and is capped by ground_n_layers.
layers._two_pass: true (default). Pass 1 castellates + snaps, pass 2 adds layers with the relaxed gate (system/snappyHexMeshDict_layering) for higher boundary-layer coverage. Costs ~30-80% more meshing time; set false for a single pass.
layers._y_plus_fit: false (default) / 'ratio' / 'full'. If the y+ target is unreachable at the current surface resolution (snappy caps a layer at maxFaceThicknessRatio x the local face): 'ratio' raises maxFaceThicknessRatio up to 0.8 only (surface_level untouched); 'full' also coarsens the finest surface level if the cap is not enough. Falls back to the plain clamp+warning if the target still cannot be built.
layers._ground_n_layers: Maximum ground layer count (default 2, never more than n_layers)
